About Tenby International School Penang

This is a collection of the links Tenby International School Penang parents use most. iSAMS Parent Portal, SchoolsBuddy, Vircle, ClassDojo, Learning Village and the other services that come with everyday life at an international school in Malaysia are gathered here in one place.

For official school information and the academic calendar, please check the school website. Use this page for quick access to the portals and learning apps you need day to day.

Online portals parents use most

iSAMS Parent Portal
The main portal for checking grades, attendance and school announcements. Log in with the account the school issues at the start of the academic year.
SchoolsBuddy
Used to book after-school activities (ECAs), clubs and school events, and to check their schedules.
Vircle
The app used for student card top-ups, uniform purchases and school store payments.
ClassDojo
Used for messaging your child's class teacher, class announcements and photo sharing.

Checklist for parents new to the school

  • Get your iSAMS Parent Portal account and confirm you can log in
  • Check the after-school activity booking dates in your SchoolsBuddy account
  • Install the Vircle app and set up student card top-ups
  • Connect with your child's class teacher on ClassDojo
  • Install the learning apps for your child's year group (Early Years and KS1: 1-Minute Maths, Raz Kids, Purple Mash, Epic)
  • Confirm your Microsoft Teams login
